entries.text: Claude Fable 5.2 reaches more boards: #1 on Epoch's Capabilities Index (174.2), Scale HLE-Diamond (72.4), Arena WebDev (1835.8), SemiAnalysis GDPx (16.4%), CWE-bench v2 (74.9) and Design Arena 3D (1542); ARC-AGI-2 93.8 at xhigh
